// Second probe for tests/unit/account-creation-behind-gate.test.ts — the
// subtle one. This file DOES import the gate and DOES call it, so an
// import-only check grades it green. It just asks after the account already
// exists, which makes the answer a log line rather than a gate, and leaves a
// Supabase auth user with no row behind it.
//
// Copy to app/api/probe-late/route.ts (as .ts) and run that test: it MUST fail
// with "calls the gate AFTER it has already created an account". Delete the
// copy afterwards.

import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server"
import { signupAllowedFor } from "@/lib/auth/registration-gate"

export async function POST(request: Request) {
    const { email, password } = await request.json()

    const supabase = await createClient()
    await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password })

    if (!(await signupAllowedFor(email))) {
        return Response.json({ error: "closed" }, { status: 403 })
    }

    const user = await db.user.create({
        data: { email, name: email.split("@")[0], roles: "policyholder" },
    })
    return Response.json({ id: user.id })
}
